status: Dated development protocol; prior benchmark outcomes have been seen; not preregistered or confirmatory
clinical_question: Does larger source training reduce the local annotation requirement for reliable pleural-effusion secondary-review thresholds after controlling optimization budget?
clinical_role: Research simulation of an additional-review flag for radiographic pleural effusion; routine interpretation continues for every image. No autonomous exclusion, emergency-triage, outcome or workload claim.
development_images: Previously evaluated VinDr 15000; preserve ldh-2026|vindr|image_id hash order, first 3000 calibration-pool and remaining 12000 assessment
development_models: All 30 frozen legacy models; use all 66 controlled source-trained models after completion for the strengthened study
primary_development_reference: majority of three independent released reader labels; operational development reference, not adjudicated clinical truth
sampling_seeds: 71000 through 71019; same nested subsets for every model and method
methods: positive-class order-statistic threshold with a nominal 95% one-sided population-sensitivity bound
threshold_rule: Predict positive if score >= t. Sort n positive calibration scores ascending. Choose largest k such that BinomialCDF(k-1;n,0.10)<=0.05; set t to kth score. If no such k exists, report insufficient evidence, not a flag-all fallback.
assumptions: Fixed scoring model; independent identically distributed positive calibration observations; same population and reference-label mechanism at assessment. Guarantees do not cover hospital or label-policy shifts. Image identifiers do not verify patient independence.
probability_calibration: Existing raw/constant/ridge-logistic comparisons remain separate. Monotonic probability recalibration alone cannot change ranking or the sensitivity-specificity tradeoff when thresholds are transformed consistently.
outcomes: threshold feasibility at each annotation budget
false negatives and false positives conditional on reference labels
fraction of resampling runs below target sensitivity
paired specificity difference among feasible methods
summary_rules: Show all requested runs and failures. Report descriptive 10th-90th percentiles across model/sampling runs, not confidence intervals. Conditional performance excludes failures only when denominators and failure rates are also explicit. Repeated draws and seeds are not independent hospitals.
final_test: VinDr official 3000 labels and performance remain locked until provenance disposition and all analysis choices are frozen. Training and test annotation mechanisms differ; test results assess that transfer and receive no automatic statistical guarantee.
novelty_boundary: Order-statistic/Neyman-Pearson error control is established methodology. Candidate contribution is evidence about data-scale, local-label budgets, reference definitions and operating-point reliability, not a new network or theorem.
